description: What is set up for hush on this machine and in this project, and what is next. Each step has a status, the exact command that does it, and a kind: auto (run it), choice (ask the user which option, then run it), or person (run it and wait: it asks the user on their screen, and you must never answer it or add --yes). Call this when the user asks you to set up hush, or when another hush tool says hush is not set up here. It never shows a secret.
name: hush_setup_status
